# World University Rankings 2023

The *Times Higher Education* World University Rankings 2023 include 1,799 universities across 104 countries and regions, making them the largest and most diverse university rankings to date.

The table is based on 13 carefully calibrated performance indicators that measure an institution’s performance across four areas: teaching, research, knowledge transfer and international outlook.

This year’s ranking analysed over 121 million citations across more than 15.5 million research publications and included survey responses from 40,000 scholars globally. Overall, we collected over 680,000 datapoints from more than 2,500 institutions that submitted data.

Trusted worldwide by students, teachers, governments and industry experts, this year’s league table reveals how the global higher education landscape is shifting.

# THE World University Rankings 2023 Released

LARGEST EDITION OF THE WORLD UNIVERSITY RANKINGS IN ITS 19TH YEAR HISTORY WITH 1,799 UNIVERSITIES FROM 104 COUNTRIES AND REGIONS RANKED.

![](https://www.timeshighereducation.com/sites/default/files/styles/the_breaking_news_image_style/public/comms_media_centre_new_new_logo_0.jpg?itok=iBVIc32P)

- **UK’s University of Oxford (1st) retains the top spot** for the seventh consecutive year.
- **A record number of 1,799 universities from 104 countries and regions are ranked,** 137 more than last year.
- **The US continues to dominate** **with 177 universities ranked overall,** including seven in the world top ten, and 12 in the top 20**,** but its supremacy is being challenged by Asia as the number of US universities represented in the top 100 continues to fall, from 43 in 2018, to 34 this year. **Harvard University** retains its position as the US’s top ranked university in 2nd place.
- **China** has an unprecedented seven universities in the world top 100 - up from six last year and just two top 100 universities only five years ago, in the 2018 edition. **Tsinghua University** becomes the best-performing Chinese institution (16th overall).
- **Japan** **leads the Asian countries** **with a total of 117 universities** ranked, followed by China with 95 and India with 75. **University of Tokyo** remains Japan’s top ranked university in 39th place.
- **In Europe, outside the UK, Switzerland’s ETH Zurich University is the highest ranked institution** (joint 11th, up from 15th place).
- **Germany achieves unprecedented global success** with nine universities in the top 100 and 22 in the top 200.
- **Asia** **is the most represented continent** **with 669 universities participating**, jointly with Europe (639, up 50 from 589 last year)**.** 
- **Singapore’s National University of Singapore** moves up to 19th position in the world top 20, while the country’s other ranked university, **Nanyang Technological University (NTU)** (36th) also rises.
- **In the Middle East and North Africa (MENA) region,** nations are thriving, led by Saudi Arabia, the United Arab Emirates and Qatar.
- **Africa** **has seen participation increase by 36.6% YoY with rankings increasing from 71 to 97 institutions** – this is the biggest increase of all continents. **Five new African countries appear in the Rankings for the first time**: Mauritius, Mozambique, Namibia, Zambia, and Zimbabwe. The highest-ranking university in Africa is **University of Cape Town** at rank 160.
- **Oceania’s average score for the region as a whole overtakes the average score of North America for the first time**.
- **Australia** **has ten universities in the top 200** with the University of Melbourne being the country’s best performing institution, ranked 34th overall (down one place from 33rd).
- **The Latin America and Caribbean region sees a record 140 universities from 12 countries ranked.** Brazil, Mexico and Colombia all have a high number of new entrants, with five newly ranked universities for Mexico and Columbia and four for Brazil.
- **Colombia’s** Icesi University is the highest-ranked new joiner in Latin America, ranked in the 601-800 band.
- **Brazil’s University of São Paulo** remains the highest ranked institution in the region, still in the 201-250 band. The regional top three is completed by Brazil’s University of Campinas and Chile’s Pontificia Universidad Católica de Chile, both still in the 401-500 band.
- **Pakistan** sees eight newly ranked Universities joining the rankings for the first time including: **University of Management and Technology (501-600); Bahria University, Dow University of Health Sciences, University of Engineering and Technology, Taxila, Riphah International University (all in 601-800), University of Engineering and Technology, Peshawar (801-1000), University of Gujrat (1001-1200) and Lahore College for Women University (LCWU) (1201-1500).**
- **South Korea has a new entrant, Chosun University (1201-1500)** and **Seoul National University** retains its position as the highest ranking University in South Korea at 56. Other Universities have risen this year in the top 200 and include: **Yonsei University (Seoul campus)** (from joint 151st to 78th), **Korea Advanced Institute of Science and Technology** (KAIST) (from =99 to joint 91st), **Pohang University of Science and Technology (POSTECH)** (from joint 185th to joint 163rd), and Ulsan National Institute of Technology (UNIST) (from joint 178th to 174th).
- **170 universities are ranked for the first time**: 74 from Asia, 53 from Europe, 25 from Africa, 17 from South America and six from North America. At country level, there are: 13 newly ranked universities from China; nine from Poland; eight from Iran; eight from Pakistan; seven from Turkey. Among these 170 universities, **Humanitas University in Italy** has the best performance and is ranked in the 201-250 band.

# Relatório — 82º Prêmios Globo de Ouro (Golden Globes 2025)

## Vencedores das Categorias de Cinema (Melhor Filme e Desempenhos)

O **82º Prêmios Globo de Ouro** foi realizado em **5 de janeiro de 2025**, no The Beverly Hilton, em Beverly Hills (EUA), sob o comando da apresentadora Nikki Glaser — primeira mulher a comandar a cerimônia sozinha. A premiação honrou os melhores filmes americanos de 2024. Abaixo, os vencedores exclusivos das categorias **cinematográficas**:

---

### 🎬 Melhor Filme — Drama
**🏆 *The Brutalist*** *(O Brutalista)*
- Indicados: *A Complete Unknown*, *Conclave*, *Dune: Part Two*, *Nickel Boys*, *September 5*

### 🎭 Melhor Filme — Comédia ou Musical
**🏆 *Emilia Pérez***
- Indicados: *Anora*, *Challengers*, *A Real Pain*, *The Substance*, *Wicked*

### 🖼️ Melhor Filme — Animação
**🏆 *Flow***
- Indicados: *Inside Out 2*, *Memoir of a Snail*, *Moana 2*, *Wallace & Gromit: Vengeance Most Fowl*, *The Wild Robot*

### 🌍 Melhor Filme — Língua Estrangeira
**🏆 *Emilia Pérez* (França)**
- Indicados: *All We Imagine as Light* (Índia), *The Girl with the Needle* (Dinamarca), *I'm Still Here* (Brasil), *The Seed of the Sacred Fig* (Alemanha), *Vermiglio* (Itália)

---

### 🔥 Destaques de Interpretação

#### Melhor Ator — Drama
**🏆 Adrien Brody** por ***The Brutalist*** (personagem László Tóth)
- Concorrentes: Timothée Chalamet (*A Complete Unknown*), Daniel Craig (*Queer*), Colman Domingo (*Sing Sing*), Ralph Fiennes (*Conclave*), Sebastian Stan (*The Apprentice*)

#### Melhor Atriz — Drama
**🏆 Fernanda Torres** por ***I'm Still Here*** (por *Eunice Paiva)*
> Marcos histórico: primeira brasileira, primeira sul-americana e primeira atriz lusófona a vencer nesse categoria no Globo de Ouro.
- Concorrentes: Pamela Anderson (*The Last Showgirl*), Angelina Jolie (*Maria*), Nicole Kidman (*Babygirl*), Tilda Swinton (*The Room Next Door*), Kate Winslet (*Lee*)

#### Melhor Ator — Comédia ou Musical
**🏆 Sebastian Stan** por ***A Different Man*** (personagens Edward Lemuel / Guy Moratz)
- Concorrentes: Jesse Eisenberg (*A Real Pain*), Hugh Grant (*Heretic*), Gabriel LaBelle (*Saturday Night*), Jesse Plemons (*Kinds of Kindness*), Glen Powell (*Hit Man*)

#### Melhor Atriz — Comédia ou Musical
**🏆 Demi Moore** por ***The Substance*** (personagem Elisabeth Sparkle)
- Concorrentes: Amy Adams (*Nightbitch*), Cynthia Erivo (*Wicked*), Karla Sofía Gascón (*Emilia Pérez*), Mikey Madison (*Anora*), Zendaya (*Challengers*)

---

### ✨ Premiações Coadjuvantes

#### Melhor Ator Coadjuvante — Filme
**🏆 Kieran Culkin** por ***A Real Pain*** (Benji Kaplan)
- Concorrentes: Yura Borisov (*Anora*), Edward Norton (*A Complete Unknown*), Guy Pearce (*The Brutalist*), Jeremy Strong (*The Apprentice*), Denzel Washington (*Gladiator II*)

#### Melhor Atriz Coadjuvante — Filme
**🏆 Zoe Saldaña** por ***Emilia Pérez*** (Rita Mora Castro)
- Concorrentes: Selena Gomez (*Emilia Pérez*), Ariana Grande (*Wicked*), Felicity Jones (*The Brutalist*), Margaret Qualley (*The Substance*), Isabella Rossellini (*Conclave*)

---

### 🎞️ Criatividade e Técnica

#### Melhor Direção
**🏆 Brady Corbet** por ***The Brutalist***
- Concorrentes: Jacques Audiard (*Emilia Pérez*), Sean Baker (*Anora*), Edward Berger (*Conclave*), Coralie Fargeat (*The Substance*), Payal Kapadia (*All We Imagine as Light*)

#### Melhor Roteiro
**🏆 Peter Straughan** por ***Conclave***
- Concorrentes: Jacques Audiard (*Emilia Pérez*), Sean Baker (*Anora*), Brady Corbet e Mona Fastvold (*The Brutalist*), Jesse Eisenberg (*A Real Pain*), Coralie Fargeat (*The Substance*)

#### Melhor Trilha Sonora Original
**🏆 Trent Reznor e Atticus Ross** por ***Challengers***
- Concorrentes: Volker Bertelmann (*Conclave*), Daniel Blumberg (*The Brutalist*), Kris Bowers (*The Wild Robot*), Clément Ducol e Camille (*Emilia Pérez*), Hans Zimmer (*Dune: Part Two*)

#### Melhor Canção Original
**🏆 "El Mal"** — Clément Ducol, Camille e Jacques Audiard (*Emilia Pérez*)
- Concorrentes: "Beautiful That Way" (Miley Cyrus), "Compress / Repress" (Luca Guadagnino), "Forbidden Road" (Robbie Williams), "Kiss the Sky" (Maren Morris), "Mi camino" (Camille e Clément Ducol)

---

### 💰 Realização Cinematográfica e Conquista de Bilheteria
**🏆 *Wicked***
- Concorrentes: *Alien: Romulus*, *Beetlejuice Beetlejuice*, *Deadpool & Wolverine*, *Gladiator II*, *Inside Out 2*, *Twisters*, *The Wild Robot*

---

## 📊 Panorama Geral

- **Maior vencedor entre os filmes:** *Emilia Pérez* (4 prêmios) — que também foi o mais indicado (10 nomeações, recorde para comédias/musicais).
- **Segundo colocado:** *The Brutalist* (3 prêmios).
- Destaque internacional: além da vitória na categoria de língua estrangeira, *Emilia Pérez* surpreendeu vencendo também Melhor Filme de Comédia/Musical.
- *Flow* se tornou o primeiro filme letão a conquistar o prêmio de Melhor Animação.

Este foi um dos eventos mais celebrados da temporada, marcado pela diversidade geográfica e cultural dos vencedores, incluindo marcos históricos como a primeira vitória de uma atriz brasileira e de uma cantora trans numa categoria principal do cinema.

The **82nd Golden Globe Awards** was an awards ceremony that honored [excellence in film](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2024_in_film "2024 in film") and [American television productions of 2024](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2024_in_American_television "2024 in American television"). The winners were revealed during the live telecast, airing on [CBS](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/CBS "CBS") and streaming on [Paramount+](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Paramount+ "Paramount+") on January 5, 2025.[[2]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/82nd_Golden_Globe_Awards#cite_note-2) The event was hosted by comedian [Nikki Glaser](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nikki_Glaser "Nikki Glaser"), making her the first solo female host in Golden Globes history.[[3]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/82nd_Golden_Globe_Awards#cite_note-Glaser-3)

The nominations were announced live on December 9, 2024, at a [press conference](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Press_conference "Press conference") at [the Beverly Hilton](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Beverly_Hilton "The Beverly Hilton") by actors [Morris Chestnut](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Morris_Chestnut "Morris Chestnut") and [Mindy Kaling](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mindy_Kaling "Mindy Kaling"), following an introduction from Golden Globes president, Helen Hoenhe.[[4]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/82nd_Golden_Globe_Awards#cite_note-Globes-4) *[Emilia Pérez](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Emilia_Pérez "Emilia Pérez")*, with 10 nominations, became the most nominated comedy/musical film in [Golden Globes history](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Golden_Globe_Awards#Superlatives "Golden Globe Awards"), just 1 shy of the overall record of 11, set by [Robert Altman](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Robert_Altman "Robert Altman")'s [country music](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Country_music "Country music") [satire](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Satire_(film_and_television) "Satire (film and television)") *[Nashville](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nashville_(film) "Nashville (film)")* in the drama category in [1976](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/33rd_Golden_Globe_Awards "33rd Golden Globe Awards").[[5]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/82nd_Golden_Globe_Awards#cite_note-5) *[The Brutalist](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Brutalist "The Brutalist")* received the second-most in film with 7 nominations, followed by *[Conclave](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Conclave_(film) "Conclave (film)")* with 6.[[6]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/82nd_Golden_Globe_Awards#cite_note-6) Additionally, *[The Bear](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Bear_(TV_series) "The Bear (TV series)")* led the television nominations with 5, followed by *[Only Murders in the Building](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Only_Murders_in_the_Building "Only Murders in the Building")* and *[Shōgun](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Shōgun_(2024_TV_series) "Shōgun (2024 TV series)")* with 4 each.[[7]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/82nd_Golden_Globe_Awards#cite_note-Variety-7)

## Ceremony information

On August 28, 2024, comedian [Nikki Glaser](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nikki_Glaser "Nikki Glaser") was announced as the host for this year's ceremony, following last year's widely criticized host, comedian [Jo Koy](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jo_Koy "Jo Koy").[[3]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/82nd_Golden_Globe_Awards#cite_note-Glaser-3) She is the first woman to host the Golden Globes solo.[[8]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/82nd_Golden_Globe_Awards#cite_note-8) Glaser herself was nominated for [Best Performance in Stand-Up Comedy on Television](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Golden_Globe_Award_for_Best_Performance_in_Stand-Up_Comedy_on_Television "Golden Globe Award for Best Performance in Stand-Up Comedy on Television") for her [HBO](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/HBO "HBO") comedy special, *Nikki Glaser: Someday You'll Die*,[[9]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/82nd_Golden_Globe_Awards#cite_note-Governors-9) but lost to [Netflix](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Netflix "Netflix")'s *Ali Wong: Single Lady*.[[10]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/82nd_Golden_Globe_Awards#cite_note-10)

The ceremony was held at 5:00 p.m. [PST](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pacific_Time_Zone "Pacific Time Zone") / 8:00 p.m. [EST](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Eastern_Time_Zone "Eastern Time Zone") on January 5, 2025. It was broadcast live on [CBS](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/CBS "CBS") and streamed on [Paramount+](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Paramount+ "Paramount+").[[4]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/82nd_Golden_Globe_Awards#cite_note-Globes-4) [Glenn Weiss](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Glenn_Weiss "Glenn Weiss") and [Ricky Kirshner](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ricky_Kirshner "Ricky Kirshner") of White Cherry Entertainment returned from last year to executive produce the ceremony, along with [Dick Clark Productions](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Dick_Clark_Productions "Dick Clark Productions").[[4]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/82nd_Golden_Globe_Awards#cite_note-Globes-4)

On December 3, 2024, it was announced that the two Lifetime Achievement Awards, which were not presented last year, would return this year; however, they were presented during an untelevised gala dinner on January 3, 2025, prior to the telecast, similar to the [Academy Awards](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Academy_Awards "Academy Awards")' [Governors Awards](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Governors_Awards "Governors Awards").[[9]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/82nd_Golden_Globe_Awards#cite_note-Governors-9) The recipient of the [Cecil B. DeMille Award](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Golden_Globe_Cecil_B._DeMille_Award "Golden Globe Cecil B. DeMille Award") was [Viola Davis](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Viola_Davis "Viola Davis"), while the [Carol Burnett Award](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Golden_Globe_Carol_Burnett_Award "Golden Globe Carol Burnett Award") was awarded to [Ted Danson](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ted_Danson "Ted Danson").[[11]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/82nd_Golden_Globe_Awards#cite_note-11)

*[Emilia Pérez](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Emilia_Pérez "Emilia Pérez")* star [Karla Sofía Gascón](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Karla_Sofía_Gascón "Karla Sofía Gascón") was the first [trans](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transgender "Transgender") nominee for a Golden Globe motion picture acting category, for the [Best Actress in a Musical or Comedy](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Golden_Globe_Award_for_Best_Actress_in_a_Motion_Picture_–_Musical_or_Comedy "Golden Globe Award for Best Actress in a Motion Picture – Musical or Comedy") category.[[12]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/82nd_Golden_Globe_Awards#cite_note-12) [Jacques Audiard](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jacques_Audiard "Jacques Audiard"), the director and writer of the film, was one of the most nominated individuals, with a total of three nominations: [Best Director](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Golden_Globe_Award_for_Best_Director "Golden Globe Award for Best Director"), [Best Screenplay](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Golden_Globe_Award_for_Best_Screenplay "Golden Globe Award for Best Screenplay"), and co-lyricist of [Best Original Song](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Golden_Globe_Award_for_Best_Original_Song "Golden Globe Award for Best Original Song") nominee "[El Mal](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/El_Mal_(song) "El Mal (song)")".[[7]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/82nd_Golden_Globe_Awards#cite_note-Variety-7) The composers and co-lyricists of the song, [Camille](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Camille_(French_singer) "Camille (French singer)") and [Clément Ducol](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Clément_Ducol "Clément Ducol"), tied Audiard for most nominated individuals. Aside from "El Mal", they were also jointly nominated for composing *Emilia Pérez*'s [Best Original Score](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Golden_Globe_Award_for_Best_Original_Score "Golden Globe Award for Best Original Score") and an additional Best Original Song nominee: "[Mi camino](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mi_camino "Mi camino")".[[7]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/82nd_Golden_Globe_Awards#cite_note-Variety-7)

This year's nominations were tabulated by [KPMG](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/KPMG "KPMG"), the U.S. audit, tax, and advisory firm, taking over [Ernst & Young](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ernst_&_Young "Ernst & Young") after fifty plus years.[[4]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/82nd_Golden_Globe_Awards#cite_note-Globes-4)[[13]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/82nd_Golden_Globe_Awards#cite_note-13)[[14]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/82nd_Golden_Globe_Awards#cite_note-14)[[15]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/82nd_Golden_Globe_Awards#cite_note-15) [Netflix](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Netflix "Netflix") received a total of 36 nominations between film and television, the most of any distributor.[[16]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/82nd_Golden_Globe_Awards#cite_note-16)

*Emilia Pérez* is the first non-English-language film (with some parts of English in the film) to win [Best Motion Picture – Musical or Comedy](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Golden_Globe_Award_for_Best_Motion_Picture_–_Musical_or_Comedy "Golden Globe Award for Best Motion Picture – Musical or Comedy"). *[Flow](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Flow_(2024_film) "Flow (2024 film)")* is the first [Latvian](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Latvian_language "Latvian language") film to win [Best Animated Feature Film](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Golden_Globe_Award_for_Best_Animated_Feature_Film "Golden Globe Award for Best Animated Feature Film").[[17]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/82nd_Golden_Globe_Awards#cite_note-17) [Fernanda Torres](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fernanda_Torres "Fernanda Torres") became the first [Brazilian](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Brazilian_Portuguese "Brazilian Portuguese") actress to win a Golden Globe in an acting category,[[18]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/82nd_Golden_Globe_Awards#cite_note-Torres-18) as well as the first Brazilian, first [South American](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/South_America "South America") and first [Portuguese-speaking](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Portuguese_language "Portuguese language") actor to win the [Golden Globe Award for Best Actress in a Motion Picture – Drama](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Golden_Globe_Award_for_Best_Actress_in_a_Motion_Picture_–_Drama "Golden Globe Award for Best Actress in a Motion Picture – Drama").[[18]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/82nd_Golden_Globe_Awards#cite_note-Torres-18) She acknowledged her mother [Fernanda Montenegro](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fernanda_Montenegro "Fernanda Montenegro")'s nomination, for *[Central Station](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Central_Station_(film) "Central Station (film)")* (1998), in the same category at the [56th Golden Globe Awards](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/56th_Golden_Globe_Awards "56th Golden Globe Awards").[[18]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/82nd_Golden_Globe_Awards#cite_note-Torres-18)

*Emilia Pérez* and *[Shōgun](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Shōgun_(2024_TV_series) "Shōgun (2024 TV series)")* were the biggest winners of the night, for film and television, respectively, with four wins each.[[19]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/82nd_Golden_Globe_Awards#cite_note-Winners-19) *[The Brutalist](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Brutalist "The Brutalist")* was the next biggest film recipient, with three wins; for television, *[Baby Reindeer](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Baby_Reindeer "Baby Reindeer")* and *[Hacks](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hacks_(TV_series) "Hacks (TV series)")* each won two.[[19]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/82nd_Golden_Globe_Awards#cite_note-Winners-19)

# 📋 Elden Ring: Shadow of the Erdtree DLC — All Remembrance Bosses & Trade Rewards

The **Shadow of the Erdtree** DLC introduces **10 Remembrance bosses**, each dropping a unique Remembrance item. These can be traded to **Finger Reader Enia** at the Roundtable Hold to unlock powerful weapons, sorceries, incantations, talismans, or Ashes of War. Below is the complete breakdown.

---

## How Remembrances Work

- Defeating a Remembrance boss grants you their associated Remembrance item (a consumable).
- You can **trade any Remembrance** to Enia once per playthrough for one of two optional rewards:
  - **Option 1:** A new weapon, tool, or colossal weapon
  - **Option 2:** A spell, incantation, or Ashes of War skill
- Alternatively, you can sell the Remembrance for **Runes** (listed under Rune Value).
- After trading, you must defeat the boss again to earn another copy of the same Remembrance.

---

## Complete DLC Remembrance Bosses Table

| # | Remembrance Boss | Remembrance Name | Location | Runes (if sold) | Option 1 Reward | Option 2 Reward |
|---|-------------------|-------------------|----------|:----------------:|------------------|------------------|
| 1 | **Divine Beast Dancing Lion** | Remembrance of the Dancing Lion | Belurat Tower Settlement (Gravesite Plain) | 30,000 | **Enraged Divine Beast** (Talisman) | **Ash of War: Divine Beast Frost Stomp** |
| 2 | **Rellana, Twin Moon Knight** | Remembrance of the Twin Moon Knight | Scadu Altus – Forest of Sinister Twisting / Scadutree area | 30,000 | **Rellana's Twin Blades** (Greatsword) | **Rellana's Twin Moons** (Sorcery) |
| 3 | **Putrescent Knight** | Remembrance of Putrescence | Village of Flies / Scadu Altus ruins | 30,000 | **Putrescence Cleaver** (Dual Hand Axe) | **Vortex of Putrescence** (Sorcery) |
| 4 | **Commander Gaius** | Remembrance of the Wild Boar Rider | Scadu Altus – Fort of Reprimand / nearby ruins | 30,000 | **Sword Lance** (Heavy Thrusting Sword) | **Blades of Stone** (Sorcery) |
| 5 | **Scadutree Avatar** | Remembrance of the Shadow Sunflower | Shadow Keep (Scadu Altus) | 40,000 | **Shadow Sunflower Blossom** (Colossal Weapon) | **Land of Shadow** (Incantation) |
| 6 | **Messmer the Impaler** | Remembrance of the Impaler | Shadow Keep (Scadu Altus) | 40,000 | **Spear of the Impaler** ( spear ) | **Messmer's Orb** (Incantation) |
| 7 | **Romina, Saint of the Bud** | Remembrance of the Saint of the Bud | Church of the Crusade / Scadutree area, Scadu Altus | 30,000 | **Poleblade of the Bud** (Poleaxe) | **Rotten Butterflies** (Incantation) |
| 8 | **Metyr, Mother of Fingers** | Remembrance of the Mother of Fingers | Cathedral of Manus Metyr (Scadu Altus) | 40,000 | **Staff of the Great Beyond** (Glintstone Staff) | **Gazing Finger** (Colossal Weapon) |
| 9 | **Midra, Lord of Frenzied Flame** | Remembrance of the Lord of Frenzied Flame | Bonny Gaol (Scadu Altus) | 40,000 | **Greatsword of Damnation** (Greatsword) | **Midra's Flame of Frenzy** (Incantation) |
| 10 | **Radahn, Consort of Miquella** | Remembrance of a God and a Lord | The Dread Mansion (Scadu Altus) | 50,000 | **Greatsword of Radahn (Light)** | **Light of Miquella** (Incantation) |

---

## Detailed Breakdown of Each Remembrance

### 1. ⚔️ Divine Beast Dancing Lion → *Remembrance of the Dancing Lion*
- **Where:** Belurat Tower Settlement, Gravesite Plain
- **Boss fight:** Fast-paced lion-dance mechanic combining physical, magic, and status attacks. Requires good evasion.
- **Trade Options:**
  - 🔯 **Enraged Divine Beast Talisman** — Increases Attack and reduces Status Effect Resistance; grants Divine Beast attack patterns.
  - 🔥 **Ash of War: Divine Beast Frost Stomp** — Adds Frost Stomp ability to any weapon (increases damage against certain foes, adds slow effect).

---

### 2. 🦆 Rellana, Twin Moon Knight → *Remembrance of the Twin Moon Knight*
- **Where:** Forest of Sinister Twisting, Scadu Altus
- **Story context:** Carian princess who switched lealdade to Messmer before his downfall.
- **Trade Options:**
  - 🗡️ **Rellana's Twin Blades** — Dual greatsword requiring both hands; strong slashing and thrusting moves.
  - ✨ **Rellana's Twin Moons** — Sorcery that fires twin crescent projectiles; useful for ranged builds.

---

### 3. 🧟 Putrescent Knight → *Remembrance of Putrescence*
- **Where:** Village of Flies, Scadu Altus
- **Boss:** Armored knight corrupted by putrescent rot.
- **Trade Options:**
  - 🪓 **Putrescence Cleaver** — Large dual-handed axe; deals physical damage and applies Bleed/Ailment.
  - 🌀 **Vortex of Putrescence** — Sorcery creating a swirling vortex of decay that pulls enemies in and inflicts Rot.

---

### 4. 🐷 Commander Gaius → *Remembrance of the Wild Boar Rider*
- **Where:** Fort of Reprimand and surrounding ruins, Scadu Altus
- **Boss:** Mounted warrior allied with Messmer.
- **Trade Options:**
  - 🛶 **Sword Lance** — Heavy thrusting sword; solid offense and knockback potential.
  - 🌫️ **Blades of Stone** — Sorcery launching stone blades in a fan pattern.

---

### 5. 🌳 Scadutree Avatar → *Remembrance of the Shadow Sunflower*
- **Where:** Shadow Keep, Scadu Altus (the legendary Scadutree in the Realm of Shadows)
- **Boss:** Massive plant-like entity embodying the shadow of the Erdtree.
- **Trade Options:**
  - 🏹 **Shadow Sunflower Blossom** — Colossal vine-throwing weapon; needs two hands, high DPS.
  - 🌑 **Land of Shadow (Incantation)** — Incantation summoning shadowy tendrils that pierce enemies with dark energy; excels against physical attackers.

---

### 6. 🛤️ Messmer the Impaler → *Remembrance of the Impaler*
- **Where:** Shadow Keep interior, Scadu Altus
- **Boss:** Serpent-possessed impaler whose mother sealed out the evil.
- **Trade Options:**
  - 🡠 **Spear of the Impaler** — Reach-focused spear ideal for mid-to-long range fighters.
  - 💫 **Messmer's Orb** — Incantation summoning a orb of black fire that tracks enemies and detonates.

---

### 7. 🌸 Romina, Saint of the Bud → *Remembrance of the Saint of the Bud*
- **Where:** Church of the Crusade, Scadu Altus
- **Boss:** Devout cleric wielding scythe-like weapons fueled by scarlet rot.
- **Trade Options:**
  - 🔪 **Poleblade of the Bud** — Poleaxe with high reach; good against groups and melee opponents.
  - 🦋 **Rotten Butterflies** — Incantation spawning flocks of butterflies that burst outward and inflict Rot/Bleed.

---

### 8. 🖕 Metyr, Mother of Fingers → *Remembrance of the Mother of Fingers*
- **Where:** Cathedral of Manus Metyr, Scadu Altus
- **Boss:** Ancient finger-weaver controlling countless Fingercreepers.
- **Trade Options:**
  - 📖 **Staff of the Great Beyond** — Powerful Glintstone Staff; excellent DPS for magic users.
  - 👁️ **Gazing Finger** — Colossal projectile resembling a massive finger; devastating single-target damage.

---

### 9. 🔥 Midra, Lord of Frenzied Flame → *Remembrance of the Lord of Frenzied Flame*
- **Where:** Bonny Gaol, Scadu Altus
- **Boss:** Burned immortal cursed to eternal agony through flame-barbed spikes.
- **Trade Options:**
  - 🗡️ **Greatsword of Damnation** — Massive two-handed greatsword; high raw DPS at the cost of mobility.
  - 🔥 **Midra's Flame of Frenzy** — Incantation channeling frantic crimson flames; fast-hit-rate AoE spell.

---

### 10. ⚭ Radahn, Consort of Miquella → *Remembrance of a God and a Lord*
- **Where:** The Dread Mansion, Scadu Altus
- **Boss:** Ancient legendary general resurrected as Miquella's consort.
- **Trade Options:**
  - ⚔️ **Greatsword of Radahn (Light form)** — Legendary greatsword with explosive finishers; available after completing the quest line fully.
  - ☀️ **Light of Miquella** — Incantation channeling Miquella's golden holy light; powerful AoE and anti-meta attacks.

---

## Summary Statistics

| Statistic | Value |
|-----------|-------|
| Total DLC Remembrance Bosses | **10** |
| Unique Remembrances dropped | **10** |
| Rune values (min–max) | **30,000 – 50,000** |
| Weapons offered | **6** (including 2 colossal) |
| Spells/Sorceries offered | **4** |
| Incantations offered | **4** |
| Talismans offered | **1** |
| Ashes of War offered | **1** |

---

## Notes

- The **Heart of Bayle** is a separate DLC reward from **Bayle the Dread** (also found in Shadow Keep), but it is **not traded with Enia** — instead, it is consumed at the Grand Altar of Dragon Communion to gain access to Bayle's Flame Lightning and Bayle's Tyranny. It does **not** fit the standard Remembrance trading system.
- After trading a Remembrance to Enia, you must **defeat the boss again** to earn another Remembrance for repeated trades.
- All DLC Remembrances are **consumable** — once used for runes or traded away, they are gone until the boss is defeated anew.

---

This covers every remembrance boss exclusive to the Shadow of the Erdtree DLC and exactly what each one offers when traded at the Roundtable Hold! Let me know if you want build recommendations based on these rewards. 🎮✨

Remembrance of the Elden Beast, hewn into the Erdtree. The power of its namesake can be unlocked by the Finger Reader. Alternatively, it can be used to gain a great bounty of runes. It was the vassal beast of the Greater Will and living incarnation of the concept of Order.

**Shadow of the Erdtree** is a fully fledged expansion for [Elden Ring](https://eldenring.wiki.fextralife.com/Elden_Ring_Wiki "Elden Ring Wiki") that adds a whole new map with 70 new Weapons, 10 new Shields, 39 new Talismans, 14 new Sorceries, 28 new Incantations, 20 new Spirit Ashes, 25 new Ashes of War, 30 new Armor Sets and new Consumables & Craftables. The expansion was announced via Twitter by the official Elden Ring account on February 28th, 2023. A Gameplay Trailer released on February 21st 2024, and a Story Trailer followed on May 21st, 2024. The release date of the [DLC](https://eldenring.wiki.fextralife.com/DLC "DLC") was June 21st, 2024.

[See all new Shadow of the Erdtree content ↵](https://eldenring.wiki.fextralife.com/Shadow_of_the_Erdtree#newcontent)
> Pure and radiant, he wields love to shrive clean the hearts of men. There is nothing more terrifying. In that forsaken place, blood must spill. The blood of your fellows, the Erdtree faithful. They were never saints. They just happened to be on the losing side of a war.
>
> Mother, wouldst thou truly Lordship sanction, in one so bereft of light? I presume you, too, are keen to know. Just What Kind Miquella is doing here.
>
> Those stripped of the Grace of Gold shall all meet death. In the embrace of Messmer's flame.
>
> Come, now. Touch the withered arm, and travel to the realm of shadow. I Will not be far behind. May we meet again.

### Elden Ring Shadow of the Erdtree Expansion: All About

- **Release Date**: June 21st, 2024
- **Platforms**: PS4 / PS5 / Xbox One / Xbox Series X|S / Steam (Physical retail versions only available for PlayStation5, Xbox Series X|S, and Steam)
- **Announcement Date**: Feb 28, 2023
- **Type**: Paid Expansion. (Base Elden Ring required in order to play **Shadow of the Erdtree**)
- **Pricing**: Standard Edition - 39.99 USD. Premium Bundle Edition - 49.99 USD. Physical Collector's Edition - 249.99 USD.
- **Content**: New Areas, 8 New Weapon Categories, New Upgrades, New Mechanics, New Quests & Storylines, New Bosses & NPCs, New Enemy Types, New Combat damage Mechanic.

### Shadow of the Erdtree Guides and Walkthrough

If you are having trouble on a certain difficult section or need some guidance regarding what to do, please don't hesitate on check on our Shadow of the Erdtree Guides:

- [Shadow of the Erdtree Walkthrough](https://eldenring.wiki.fextralife.com/Shadow_of_the_Erdtree_Walkthrough "Shadow of the Erdtree Walkthrough"): Check our detailed Walkthrough to learn all about Shadow of the Erdtree's secrets,
- [Shadow of the Erdtree Game Progress Route](https://eldenring.wiki.fextralife.com/Shadow_Lands_Game_Progress_Route "Shadow Lands Game Progress Route"): If you want a more streamlined guide and don't need a full in-depth guidance.

## Elden Ring Shadow of the Erdtree Content & Mechanics

### Level-Scaling Mechanic

This leveling mechanic introduced in the DLC is optional and can be ignored by players if they feel it will affect the game too much. In the Shadow of the Erdtree expansion, players can gather Scadutree Fragments scattered around the map. Once enough have been collected, a new option will appear as you rest on a Site of Grace. This will increase the level of your Scadutree Blessing, which increases the amount of damage you deal, and reduces the damage you receive from [Enemies](https://eldenring.wiki.fextralife.com/Enemies "Enemies") and [Bosses](https://eldenring.wiki.fextralife.com/Bosses "Bosses").

This **DOES NOT** mean that previous leveling in the main game does not matter, or that this new leveling mechanic replaces the old one. If you are level **200+** and have all your [Weapons](https://eldenring.wiki.fextralife.com/Weapons "Weapons") fully upgraded, you will probably be overleveled for the DLC. It is also important to note that the benefits from the Scadurtree Fragments only work on the Realm of Shadows and will not grant players benefits if they return to the Lands Between.

### Shadow of the Erdtree Revered Spirit Ashes

Revered Spirit Ashes is another mechanic introduced in the Shadow of the Erdtree expansion. This mechanic allows [Spirit Ashes](https://eldenring.wiki.fextralife.com/Spirit_Ashes "Spirit Ashes") and Summons to be boosted to **+10**, allowing them to continue to scale with you in the DLC. This mechanic also increases durability and health for [Torrent](https://eldenring.wiki.fextralife.com/Torrent "Torrent"), your spectral steed.

Like the new level-scaling mechanic, Revered Spirit Ashes are only operational while you are in the Realm of Shadows and does not work in the Lands Between.

## How to access Shadow of the Erdtree?

The first thing to know is how to access the new content added with the Shadow of the Erdtree DLC. The Lands Between will remain in their constant wage for power and the main game's original story will be there waiting for us any time we decide to return, but in order to access the new content in the DLC, players will have to reach a certain point in the story.

### Defeat both Starcourge Radahn and Mohg, Lord of Blood

These two bosses have to be defeated in order to be able to start the DLC. Given that [Mohg, Lord of Blood](https://eldenring.wiki.fextralife.com/Mohg,_Lord_of_Blood "Mohg, Lord of Blood") is one of the most challenging and, probably late-game [Bosses](https://eldenring.wiki.fextralife.com/Bosses "Bosses"), players will face, he will probably be defeated **AFTER** already having defeated [Starscourge Radahn](https://eldenring.wiki.fextralife.com/Starscourge_Radahn "Starscourge Radahn"). The DLC is expected to be difficult and around the same level as [Crumbling Farum Azula](https://eldenring.wiki.fextralife.com/Crumbling_Farum_Azula "Crumbling Farum Azula"), in terms of challenge.

### Interact with [Miquella's](https://eldenring.wiki.fextralife.com/Miquella "Miquella") Cocoon

After defeating Mohg, Lord of Blood, a new Site of Grace will appear in the battlefield. Rest there and interact with Miquella's Cocoon at the back of the room. This will trigger the events of the DLC, and lead players to the Realm of Shadow.

### What to expect from the Shadow of the Erdtree Expansion

Given FromSoftware's previous releases and the fact that the expansion is being announced more than a year after Elden Ring's official launch, we speculate that this content is a fully-fledged expansion meant to add significant content to the game.

Unlike the [Colosseum Update](https://eldenring.wiki.fextralife.com/Collosseum_DLC "Collosseum DLC"), which featured content that had already been hinted at with the base game, the **Shadows of the Erdtree** expansion should feature entire new areas, weapons, equipment, bosses, and discoveries. The zone features on the image for the game are already different than any available in-game at the moment, and it is likely to expand on the Lore and background of the world.

The expansion features its own “mini logo” which is often a signal for a large content expansion, but the main driving force behind the content size speculation is the amount of time that it has taken FromSoftware to reveal that the content is in the works. We initially estimated that they must have been working on this for some time, announcing development in Feb 2023, and expect a launch date to be revealed around Q2 with a release date for Q3 or Q4 2023.

#### New Story

Guided by the [Empyrean](https://eldenring.wiki.fextralife.com/Empyrean "Empyrean") Miquella, players are beckoned to the Land of Shadow, a place obscured by the Erdtree where the goddess Marika first set foot. In these strange new lands, players discover the dark secrets of the world as they meet others who follow in Miquella’s footsteps with ulterior motives.

#### New Location

**Elden Ring Shadow of the Erdtree** takes players beyond the Lands Between to explore the Land of Shadow, a completely new world from **Elden Ring**. Players can seamlessly travel back and forth between its vast maps interspersed with diverse situations and meticulous dungeons where menacing enemies roam.

#### New Content

**Shadow of the Erdtree** adds new [Weapons](https://eldenring.wiki.fextralife.com/Weapons "Weapons"), equipment, weapon skills and [Magic](https://eldenring.wiki.fextralife.com/Magic "Magic") not found in the base game **ELDEN RING**, along with new [Enemies](https://eldenring.wiki.fextralife.com/Enemies "Enemies"), [Boss](https://eldenring.wiki.fextralife.com/Bosses "Bosses") encounters and plotlines to further increase players' RPG freedom. Take on these threats with the new powers you can acquire.

### Shadow of the Erdtree Story Trailer

Released on May 21st, the Shadow of the Erdtree Story trailer sets the stage for the events of the [DLC](https://eldenring.wiki.fextralife.com/DLC "DLC"). As is the case with most From Software trailers, there are many pieces of lore to pick up but not enough to form the whole puzzle and have a clear image of what is going on. Regardless, there are a few theories:

- The beginning of the trailer shows a hand, presumably Marika's, grabbing golden threads from a viscera-like container. Many From Software titles do make this evocative images about birth, which may be a paralelism about the birth of a faction or even a demigod.
- At the beginning, there is also mention about a seduction and a betrayal, and then is completed with the lines "An affair from which gold arose. And so too was Shadow born." This may refer to the creation of the Erdtree, and what it represents, but also the birth of Shadow and the Shadowlands.
- Given that the Erdtree replaced the Great Tree once Marika mended it, and the location of the Erdtree in the original Elden Ring, it is not far-fetched to think that the Land of Shadows, which according to Miyazaki has been "sundered from the Lands Between", will be found in the area of the map below Leyndell, and above Limgrave/Caelid.
- The hand has a snake bangle. Snakes are considered blasphemy in the current time of Elden Ring.
- "What followed was a war unseen, one that could never be put to song". This lines, spoken after the birth of gold and shadow, is followed by images of Messmer's Army razing a flaming city. As the army marches onward, Messmer is standing on high ground, as the lines "A purge without grace or honour." are displayed.
- Later on the trailer, the Lion Dancer enemy or boss, attacks a soldier of Messmer's Army, and on the following take, procedes to attack him, and the following shot shows Messmer invoking fire from his right hand. After that take, three Lion Dancers seem to be impaled on spears among the fire ruins.
- Miquella abandons everything, even getting rid of his flesh, which is a way to get out of the influence of the Greater Will.
- When the trailer displays "And so kindly Miquella would abandon everything". It shows what it seems to be Miquella's Great Rune. Another theory is that the Shadowlands won't have sites of grace, and feature instead these types of guidance throughour the DLC area.
- A group of people, are looking up to the mentioned Great Rune. Following Miquella's footsteps along the new area.

## Elden Ring Shadow of the Erdtree FAQ

### When does Shadow of the Erdtree Come out?

As revealed on the gameplay trailer released on February 21st, **Shadow of the Erdtree** will release on June 21st, 2024

### For which platforms Shadow of the Erdtree will be available?

**Shadow of the Erdtree** is releasing on PS4, PS5, Xbox One, Xbox Series X and S, and PC. Do note that Physical retail versions will be only available for PlayStation5, Xbox Series X|S, and PC, but not on the previous console generation (Playstation 4 and Xbox One)

### How can Shadow of the Erdtree be accessed?

Both [Starscourge Radahn](https://eldenring.wiki.fextralife.com/Starscourge_Radahn "Starscourge Radahn") and [Mohg, Lord of Blood](https://eldenring.wiki.fextralife.com/Mohg,_Lord_of_Blood "Mohg, Lord of Blood") must be defeated to access the DLC when it is released. Players can then enter the DLC by interacting with the withering arm on the cocoon in Mohg's boss arena.

### Did George R. R. Martin provide new material for Shadow of the Erdtree?

Confirmed by Miyazaki, Game of Thrones author George R.R. Martin did not provide new material for the Shadow of the Erdtree expansion. The DLC is based on one part of the mythos the fantasy writer originally created for FromSoftware during the base Elden Ring development.

### Will I be locked into the Expansion once I start Shadow of the Erdtree?

No. Players will have the chance to return to Lands Between at any given time and won't be locked into the DLC content.

### Is Shadow of the Erdtree a stand-alone expansion?

No. Shadow of the Erdtree is a massive addition to the already immense world of Elden Ring, and it requires players to have the original Elden Ring edition already installed. Players that don't possess the original game, WILL NOT be able to play Shadow of the Erdtree.

### Will there be more expansions after Shadow of the Erdtree?

Miyazaki stated there are currently no plans for further DLC, although at the same time he claimed that doesn't mean everything in Elden Ring is complete and that he doesn't want to make any statements which close off future possibilities. From Software has a track record of releasing at least one paid DLC package for their games, but it remains to be seen if a second DLC comes after Shadow of the Erdtree.

### What will Shadow of the Erdtree difficulty level be?

According to Miyazaki, the difficulty level is on a similar footing with the end game of the base game. Shadow of the Erdtree will also include a separate, limited to the DLC level up system affecting attack power so that even high level players may face new challenges and may enter or avoid areas based on enemy difficulty. He compared this to Attack Power in Sekiro: Shadows Die Twice, and also stated it can be opted out of entirely for a greater challenge.

Developers start most players that tried Shadow of the Erdtree during the test at level 150, but depending on your abilities and [Builds](https://eldenring.wiki.fextralife.com/Builds "Builds"), players may start at around level 100 to 120.

A **[Copa Libertadores da América](https://pt.wikipedia.org/wiki/Copa_Libertadores_da_América "Copa Libertadores da América") de [2023](https://pt.wikipedia.org/wiki/2023 "2023")**, oficialmente **CONMEBOL Libertadores 2023**, foi a 64.ª edição da competição de futebol realizada anualmente pela [Confederação Sul-Americana de Futebol](https://pt.wikipedia.org/wiki/Confederação_Sul-Americana_de_Futebol "Confederação Sul-Americana de Futebol") (CONMEBOL). Participaram clubes das dez associações sul-americanas.

Em 8 de março, a CONMEBOL anunciou que a partida final da competição seria disputada no [estádio do Maracanã](https://pt.wikipedia.org/wiki/Estádio_Jornalista_Mário_Filho "Estádio Jornalista Mário Filho"), no [Rio de Janeiro](https://pt.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rio_de_Janeiro "Rio de Janeiro").[[2]](https://pt.wikipedia.org/wiki/Copa_Libertadores_da_Am%C3%A9rica_de_2023#cite_note-2) Inicialmente marcada para ocorrer em 11 de novembro, foi antecipada em uma semana, passando para 4 de novembro.[[3]](https://pt.wikipedia.org/wiki/Copa_Libertadores_da_Am%C3%A9rica_de_2023#cite_note-finaldata-3)

O [Fluminense](https://pt.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fluminense_Football_Club "Fluminense Football Club") conquistou o seu primeiro título na competição ao superar o [Boca Juniors](https://pt.wikipedia.org/wiki/Club_Atlético_Boca_Juniors "Club Atlético Boca Juniors") na [final](https://pt.wikipedia.org/wiki/Final_da_Copa_Libertadores_da_América_de_2023 "Final da Copa Libertadores da América de 2023") por 2–1, após a [prorrogação](https://pt.wikipedia.org/wiki/Prorrogação "Prorrogação").[[4]](https://pt.wikipedia.org/wiki/Copa_Libertadores_da_Am%C3%A9rica_de_2023#cite_note-4) Com isso, teve o direito de enfrentar o campeão da [Copa Sul-Americana de 2023](https://pt.wikipedia.org/wiki/Copa_Sul-Americana_de_2023 "Copa Sul-Americana de 2023") na [Recopa Sul-Americana de 2024](https://pt.wikipedia.org/wiki/Recopa_Sul-Americana_de_2024 "Recopa Sul-Americana de 2024"), assim como se classificou automaticamente para a fase de grupos da [Copa Libertadores da América de 2024](https://pt.wikipedia.org/wiki/Copa_Libertadores_da_América_de_2024 "Copa Libertadores da América de 2024") e para a [Copa do Mundo de Clubes de 2023](https://pt.wikipedia.org/wiki/Copa_do_Mundo_de_Clubes_da_FIFA_de_2023 "Copa do Mundo de Clubes da FIFA de 2023") e o [Mundial de Clubes de 2025](https://pt.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mundial_de_Clubes_FIFA_de_2025 "Mundial de Clubes FIFA de 2025").

## Equipes classificadas

As seguintes 47 equipes das 10 federações filiadas à CONMEBOL se qualificaram para o torneio:[[5]](https://pt.wikipedia.org/wiki/Copa_Libertadores_da_Am%C3%A9rica_de_2023#cite_note-5)

- Campeão da Copa Libertadores da América de 2022
- Campeão da Copa Sul-Americana de 2022
- Brasil: 7 vagas
- Argentina: 6 vagas
- Demais associações: 4 vagas cada

A fase de entrada é determinada da seguinte maneira:

- **Fase de grupos: 28 equipes**
  - Campeão da Copa Libertadores de 2022;
  - Campeão da Copa Sul-Americana de 2022;
  - Equipes qualificadas para as vagas 1 a 5 da Argentina e do Brasil;
  - Equipes qualificadas para as vagas 1 e 2 de todas as outras associações.
- **Segunda fase: 13 equipes**
  - Equipes qualificadas para as vagas 6 e 7 do Brasil;
  - Equipe que qualificou para a vaga 6 da Argentina;
  - Equipes qualificadas para as vagas 3 e 4 do Chile e Colômbia;
  - Equipes qualificadas para a vaga 3 de todas as outras associações.
- **Primeira fase: 6 equipes**
  - Equipes que se qualificaram para a vaga 4 da Bolívia, Equador, Paraguai, Peru, Uruguai e Venezuela.

## Premiação financeira

Em 17 de março, a CONMEBOL anunciou uma mudança na premiação em dinheiro da competição. A partir desta edição, os clubes foram premiados por cada vitória na fase de grupos. O valor pago, por vitória, foi de 300 mil [dólares](https://pt.wikipedia.org/wiki/Dólar_dos_Estados_Unidos "Dólar dos Estados Unidos") — cerca de 1,5 milhão de [reais](https://pt.wikipedia.org/wiki/Real_(moeda_brasileira) "Real (moeda brasileira)"). Conforme o comunicado da entidade, o objetivo é "*reconhecer os méritos esportivos*". Também houve um aumento nos valores das premiações em cerca de 23 [por cento](https://pt.wikipedia.org/wiki/Porcentagem "Porcentagem") em relação a edição do ano passado e a competição distribuiu 207 milhões de dólares ou cerca de 1,087 bilhão de reais.[[6]](https://pt.wikipedia.org/wiki/Copa_Libertadores_da_Am%C3%A9rica_de_2023#cite_note-6)[[7]](https://pt.wikipedia.org/wiki/Copa_Libertadores_da_Am%C3%A9rica_de_2023#cite_note-7)

## Fases preliminares

Ver artigo principal: [Fases preliminares da Copa Libertadores da América de 2023](https://pt.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fases_preliminares_da_Copa_Libertadores_da_América_de_2023 "Fases preliminares da Copa Libertadores da América de 2023")

Nas fases preliminares cada emparelhamento foi definido em partidas eliminatórias de ida e volta. Em caso de empate no placar agregado, a vaga seria definida direto na [disputa por pênaltis](https://pt.wikipedia.org/wiki/Disputa_por_pênaltis "Disputa por pênaltis"), sem prorrogação. Os confrontos das duas primeiras fases foram definidos através de sorteio.[[14]](https://pt.wikipedia.org/wiki/Copa_Libertadores_da_Am%C3%A9rica_de_2023#cite_note-regulam-15)

- **Primeira fase:** disputada por seis equipes provenientes de Bolívia, Equador, Paraguai, Peru, Uruguai e Venezuela, qualifica três para a seguinte fase.
- **Segunda fase:** disputada por 16 equipes, sendo 13 delas provenientes de Argentina, Bolívia, Brasil, Chile, Colômbia, Equador, Paraguai, Peru, Uruguai e Venezuela mais os três vencedores da fase anterior, qualifica oito equipes para a seguinte fase.
- **Terceira fase:** disputada pelas oito equipes vencedoras da fase anterior, as quatro vencedoras avançam para a fase de grupos com as outras 28 equipes e a quatro perdedoras sendo transferidas para a [fase de grupos](https://pt.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fase_de_grupos_da_Copa_Sul-Americana_de_2023 "Fase de grupos da Copa Sul-Americana de 2023") da [Copa Sul-Americana de 2023](https://pt.wikipedia.org/wiki/Copa_Sul-Americana_de_2023 "Copa Sul-Americana de 2023").

## Fase de grupos

Ver artigo principal: [Fase de grupos da Copa Libertadores da América de 2023](https://pt.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fase_de_grupos_da_Copa_Libertadores_da_América_de_2023 "Fase de grupos da Copa Libertadores da América de 2023")

Os vencedores e os segundos classificados de cada grupo avançam para as oitavas de final, enquanto os terceiros colocados foram transferidos para os *play-offs* da [Copa Sul-Americana de 2023](https://pt.wikipedia.org/wiki/Copa_Sul-Americana_de_2023 "Copa Sul-Americana de 2023").

Nessa fase, cada grupo é disputado em turno e returno, todos contra todos. As equipes são classificadas de acordo com os seguintes critérios:[[14]](https://pt.wikipedia.org/wiki/Copa_Libertadores_da_Am%C3%A9rica_de_2023#cite_note-regulam-15)

1. Pontos (três pontos por vitória, um ponto por empate e nenhum ponto por derrota)
2. Saldo de gols
3. Gols marcados
4. Gols marcados fora de casa
5. [Ranking CONMEBOL](https://pt.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ranking_CONMEBOL "Ranking CONMEBOL")

## Fase final

Ver artigo principal: [Fase final da Copa Libertadores da América de 2023](https://pt.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fase_final_da_Copa_Libertadores_da_América_de_2023 "Fase final da Copa Libertadores da América de 2023")

Após a conclusão da fase de grupos, um sorteio, em 5 de julho — na sede da CONMEBOL, em Luque, no Paraguai — definiu o chaveamento das equipes classificadas a partir das oitavas de final até a final.[[15]](https://pt.wikipedia.org/wiki/Copa_Libertadores_da_Am%C3%A9rica_de_2023#cite_note-regulamento-16)[[11]](https://pt.wikipedia.org/wiki/Copa_Libertadores_da_Am%C3%A9rica_de_2023#cite_note-uol_definido_sorteio_oitavas-11)

As equipes que finalizaram em primeiro lugar na fase de grupos (pote 1 no sorteio) enfrentam as equipes que finalizaram em segundo lugar (pote 2), não havendo restrições nos confrontos, portanto podendo ser sorteadas equipes de um mesmo país ou que integraram o mesmo grupo na fase anterior. A pontuação obtida na fase de grupos serve para a definição dos mandos de campo até a semifinal, com as equipes melhores posicionadas sempre realizando o jogo de volta como equipe mandante, sendo numeradas de 1 a 16.[[15]](https://pt.wikipedia.org/wiki/Copa_Libertadores_da_Am%C3%A9rica_de_2023#cite_note-regulamento-16)[[11]](https://pt.wikipedia.org/wiki/Copa_Libertadores_da_Am%C3%A9rica_de_2023#cite_note-uol_definido_sorteio_oitavas-11)

# 📋 Relatório Completo — Lembranças do DLC Shadow of the Erdtree

## 📌 Como Funciona

Ao derrotar cada chefe, você recebe sua **Lembrança** (Boss Soul). Ela pode ser:
1. **Trocada com Finger Reader Enia** (Roundtable Hold) por uma das **2 opções exclusivas** do chefe (você escolhe);
2. **Consumida diretamente** na hora, recebendo uma quantia fixa de Runas.

> ⚠️ **Nota:** A troca é feita apenas com **Enia**. Após trocar, você fica impedido de usar aquela mesma Lembrança novamente nessa troca.

## ⚡ Bônus Especial: Coração de Bayle (não é uma Lembrança tradicional)

O chefe **Bayle the Dread** concede um item único separado — o **Heart of Bayle**. Ao consumi-lo no Grand Altar of Dragon Communion, você escolhe **apenas UMA** das duas incantações:

| Recompensa Escolhida | Tipo | Descrição |
|----------------------|------|-----------|
| **Bayle's Flame Lightning** | Incantation | Relâmpago invocado pelo coração de Bayle |
| **Bayle's Tyranny** | Incantation | Domínio opressor que debilita inimigos |

> ⚠️ Você só pode selecionar **uma** dessas incantações por progressão de jogo — não são acumulativas.

## 💡 Dicas Estratégicas

- **Priorize a Lembrança de Radahn** se quiser maximizar runas — vale 50.000, a maior do DLC.
- **Se você já domina armas brancas**, prefira as opções 1 (armas/talismãs) que costumam ser mais versáteis para o combate.
- **Magistas devem focar nas incantações únicas** — algumas têm atributos muito específicos (ex.: Int 72+ para Rellana's Twin Moons, Fai 72 para Light of Miquella).
- Você pode **duplicar Lembranças** usando o Kit de Fabricação em certas localidades — mas isso exige gastar Materiais Nobres.

conversa_com_ferramentas.content:
# All Elden Ring DLC Shadow of the Erdtree Remembrance bosses and rewards

There are 10 new **Remembrance** [bosses](https://www.polygon.com/elden-ring-shadow-erdtree-guide/24180254/all-dlc-boss-locations-bosses-in-order) to fight in [Elden Ring](https://www.polygon.com/elden-ring-guide-walkthrough)’s [Shadow of the Erdtree](https://www.polygon.com/elden-ring-shadow-erdtree-guide/24180113/dlc-walkthroughs-guides) DLC. Like the 15 [Remembrances](https://www.polygon.com/elden-ring-guide-walkthrough/23057307/remembrance-duplicate-boss-items-finger-reader-enia-consume-exchange) from the original Elden Ring, these grant you elite [weapons](https://www.polygon.com/elden-ring-shadow-erdtree-guide/24180256/all-new-dlc-weapon-locations), spells, and [talismans](https://www.polygon.com/elden-ring-shadow-erdtree-guide/24177999/talisman-locations-all-dlc-sote) to play with.

Our Elden Ring guide lists **all new DLC Remembrances** introduced in Shadow of the Erdtree. After defeating each of the following major bosses, take their Remembrances to Finger Reader Enia at Roundtable Hold to cash them in for special items. For even more, see our guide on how to [duplicate Remembrances](https://www.polygon.com/e/23948974).

**Spoiler warning:** This guide contains minor spoilers for Shadow of the Erdtree.

---

## **Divine Beast Dancing Lion**

![Artwork of the Divine Beast Dancing Lion Remembrance from Elden Ring: Shadow of the Erdtree](https://static0.polygonimages.com/wordpress/wp-content/uploads/chorus/uploads/chorus_asset/file/25504607/remembrance_dancing_lion.jpg?q=70&fit=crop&w=825&dpr=1)Image: FromSoftware/Bandai Namco via Polygon

**Remembrance**: Remembrance of the Dancing Lion  
**Boss:** Divine Beast Dancing Lion  
**Location:** Belurat, Tower Settlement, beyond Stagefront Site of Grace

### **Reward #1: Enraged Divine Beast**

- **Type:** [Talisman](https://www.polygon.com/elden-ring-shadow-erdtree-guide/24177999/talisman-locations-all-dlc-sote)
- **Effect:** Raises potency of storms.

### **Reward #2: Divine Beast Frost Stomp**

- **Type:** Ash of War
- **Description:** This Ash of War grants an armament the Cold affinity and the skill Divine Beast Frost Stomp, a skill that imitates the wrath of the divine beast’s dance. Lift a leg up high and stamp it down with great force. Sends a powerful wave of frost straight out along the ground. Can be charged to increase power and range.
- **FP Cost:** 18

---

## **Rellana, Twin Moon Knight**

![Artwork of the Rellana, Twin Moon Knight Remembrance from Elden Ring: Shadow of the Erdtree](https://static0.polygonimages.com/wordpress/wp-content/uploads/chorus/uploads/chorus_asset/file/25504608/remembrance_twin_moon_knight.jpg?q=70&fit=crop&w=825&dpr=1)Image: FromSoftware/Bandai Namco via Polygon

**Remembrance:** Remembrance of the Twin Moon Knight  
**Boss:** [Rellana, Twin Moon Knight](https://www.polygon.com/elden-ring-shadow-erdtree-guide/24182436/rellana-location-weakness-strategy-how-to-beat-sote-dlc)  
**Location:** [Castle Ensis](https://www.polygon.com/elden-ring-shadow-erdtree-guide/24180357/castle-ensis-walkthrough-dlc-sote), beyond Castle-Lord’s Chamber Site of Grace

### **Reward #1: Rellana’s Twin Blades**

- **Type:** Light Greatsword (Standard/Pierce)
- **Description:** Carian light greatsword embedded with blue glintstone. Two swords as a single armament. When [two-handing](https://www.polygon.com/elden-ring-guide-walkthrough/22950765/two-hand-weapons-how-to-controller-keyboard), a straight sword engraved with golden flame will be carried in the left hand. Here, and here alone, were moon and fire ever together.
- **Unique Skill:** Moon-and-Fire Stance. Assume ready stance, swords imbued with magic. Follow up with normal attack to cast glintsone light waves, or a strong attack to perform a spinning attack that bathes the area with flame. Light waves can have up to two-follow-up casts with additional inputs.
- **Attributes Required:** Str 13, Dex 16, Int 16, Fai 16

### **Reward #2: Rellana’s Twin Moons**

- **Type:** Sorcery
- **Description:** Incarnate overlapping twin moons which strike the ground one after the other, violently shaking the earth with moonlight. In her childhood, she and her elder sister Rennala met these moons. Overlapping, as though nestled against one another.
- **Attributes Required:** Int 72

---

## **Messmer the Impaler**

![Artwork of the Messmer the Impaler Remembrance from Elden Ring: Shadow of the Erdtree](https://static0.polygonimages.com/wordpress/wp-content/uploads/chorus/uploads/chorus_asset/file/25504609/remembrance_impaler.jpg?q=70&fit=crop&w=825&dpr=1)Image: FromSoftware/Bandai Namco via Polygon

**Remembrance:** Remembrance of the Impaler  
**Boss:** [Messmer the Impaler](https://www.polygon.com/elden-ring-shadow-erdtree-guide/24184831/messmer-location-weakness-strategy-how-to-beat-sote-dlc)  
**Location:** [Shadow Keep](https://www.polygon.com/elden-ring-shadow-erdtree-guide/24180868/shadow-keep-walkthrough-dlc-sote), beyond Dark Chamber Entrance Site of Grace

### **Reward #1: Spear of the Impaler**

- **Type:** Great Spear (Standard/Pierce)
- **Description:** A great spear with a warped blade in the shape of undulating flame. Remade by the forging arts of the real of shadow, this weapon can be thrown by executing a strong attack, dashing strong attack, or mounted strong attack. Charge the attack to produce flame on impact.
- **Unique Skill:** Messmer’s Assault. A fierce succession of attacks using a flame-coated spear tip. Repeated inputs allow up to two follow-up attacks. The final move thrusts the spear into the ground, causing countless spears to form in the surrounding area.
- **Attributes Required:** Str 14, Dex 35, Fai 18

### **Reward #2: Messmer’s Orb**

- **Type:** Incantation
- **Description:** Summons Messmer’s flame to form a giant floating orb. The orb soars toward a foe, crashes into the earth, and explodes after a brief delay. Charging enhances potency.
- **Attributes Required:** Fai 60

---

## **Midra, Lord of Frenzied Flame**

![Artwork of the Midra, Lord of Frenzied Flame Remembrance from Elden Ring: Shadow of the Erdtree](https://static0.polygonimages.com/wordpress/wp-content/uploads/chorus/uploads/chorus_asset/file/25504611/remembrance_lord_frenzied_flame.jpg?q=70&fit=crop&w=825&dpr=1)Image: FromSoftware/Bandai Namco via Polygon

**Remembrance:** Remembrance of the Lord of Frenzied Flame  
**Boss:** [Midra, Lord of Frenzied Flame](https://www.polygon.com/elden-ring-shadow-erdtree-guide/24191494/midra-location-weakness-strategy-how-to-beat-sote-dlc)  
**Location:** Midra’s Manse, from Second Floor Chamber Site of Grace

### **Reward #1: Greatsword of Damnation**

- **Type:** Greatsword (Standard/Pierce)
- **Description:** Golden greatsword that once pierced the body of Midra, master of the manse. Used by the hornsent in the execution of a damnation like no other. The barbs that pierce the victim from within wind gently around the blade.
- **Unique Skill:** Golden Crux. Leap up and skewer foe from overhead. If successful, the weapon’s barbs unfold to excruciate from within; else, additional input releases barbs in the area. There is something of the Golden Order in the sight of those fixed upon this crux.
- **Attributes Required:** Str 20, Dex 15, Fai 20

### **Reward #2: Midra’s Flame of Frenzy**

- **Type:** Incantation
- **Description:** Summons an apparition of the Lord’s head to spew frenzied flame. This incantation can be used while in motion. The apparition will remain for as long as the input is held.
- **Attributes Required:** Fai 41

---

## **Putrescent Knight**

![Artwork of the Putrescent Knight Remembrance from Elden Ring: Shadow of the Erdtree](https://static0.polygonimages.com/wordpress/wp-content/uploads/chorus/uploads/chorus_asset/file/25504613/remembrance_putrescence.jpg?q=70&fit=crop&w=825&dpr=1)Image: FromSoftware/Bandai Namco via Polygon

**Remembrance:** Remembrance of Putrescence  
**Boss:** [Putrescent Knight](https://www.polygon.com/elden-ring-shadow-erdtree-guide/24185730/putrescent-knight-location-weakness-strategy-how-to-beat-sote-dlc)  
**Location:** Stone Coffin Fissure, from Fissure Depths Site of Grace

### **Reward #1: Putrescence Cleaver**

- **Type:** Greataxe
- **Effect:** Causes Frost buildup (55)
- **Description:** A great cleaver of hardened putrescence affixed to an arch fashioned from human bones. Gains power from the wielder’s arcane attribute.
- **Unique Skill:** Spinning Guillotine. Hold the putrid blade at both ends and arch you body backwards to deliver a powerful overhead chop. Repeated inputs deliver follow-up attacks for as long as stamina allows. Strong attack performs a leap forward followed by a spinning attack.
- **Attributes Required:** Str 28, Dex 10, Arc 15

### **Reward #2: Vortex of Putrescence**

- **Type:** Sorcery
- **Description:** Launches a whirl of putrescent jets that explode shortly after impact and bathe the area in ghost flame.
- **Attributes Required:** Int 32, Fai 26

---

## **Scadutree Avatar**

![Artwork of the Scadutree Avatar Remembrance from Elden Ring: Shadow of the Erdtree](https://static0.polygonimages.com/wordpress/wp-content/uploads/chorus/uploads/chorus_asset/file/25504614/remembrance_shadow_sunflower.jpg?q=70&fit=crop&w=825&dpr=1)Image: FromSoftware/Bandai Namco via Polygon

**Remembrance:** Remembrance of the Shadow Sunflower  
**Boss:** [Scadutree Avatar](https://www.polygon.com/elden-ring-shadow-erdtree-guide/24186490/scadutree-avatar-location-weakness-strategy-how-to-beat-sote-dlc)  
**Location:** [Shadow Keep](https://www.polygon.com/elden-ring-shadow-erdtree-guide/24180868/shadow-keep-walkthrough-dlc-sote), Church District from Tree-Worshipping Sanctum

### **Reward #1: Shadow Sunflower Blossom**

- **Type:** Colossal Weapon (Strike)
- **Description:** The head of a monstrous shadow sunflower manifestation of the Scadutree. Then again, it might just be a flower, wielded as a weapon.
- **Unique Skill:** Shadow Sunflower Headbutt. Slam down the blossom of a large shadow sunflower, sending out a shockwave that flattens foes. Repeated inputs allow for up to two follow-up attacks.
- **Attributes Required:** Str 24, Dex 8, Fai 25

### **Reward #2: Land of Shadow**

- **Type:** Incantation
- **Description:** Creates a hail of golden projectiles that are fired toward foes after a brief delay.
- **Attributes Required:** Fai 58

---

## **Commander Gaius**

![Artwork of the Commander Gaius Remembrance from Elden Ring: Shadow of the Erdtree](https://static0.polygonimages.com/wordpress/wp-content/uploads/chorus/uploads/chorus_asset/file/25504615/remembrance_wild_boar_rider.jpg?q=70&fit=crop&w=825&dpr=1)Image: FromSoftware/Bandai Namco via Polygon

**Remembrance:** Remembrance of the Wild Boar Rider  
**Boss:** [Commander Gaius](https://www.polygon.com/elden-ring-shadow-erdtree-guide/24186445/commander-gaius-location-weakness-strategy-how-to-beat-sote-dlc)  
**Location:** Scaduview, beyond Shadow Keep, Back Gate Site of Grace

### **Reward #1: Sword Lance**

- **Type:** Heavy Thrusting Sword (Standard/Pierce)
- **Description:** A combination of greatsword and lance. Weighty and capable of being brought to bear with great force, this armament shows its true potential when used astride a mount. Gaius himself was never without his boar.
- **Skill:** Spinning Gravity Thrust. A gravity skill honed by the disciples of an Alabaster Lord. Uses gravitational power to hang in the air before rotating the body and charging forward. An additional input allows for a follow-up attack.
- **Attributes Required:** Str 21, Dex 11

### **Reward #2: Blades of Stone**

- **Type:** Sorcery
- **Description:** Pulls blade-like clumps of rock from the earth. Charging increases potency. Gaius and Radahn were good rivals in their youth, and this sorcery is a product of their friendly competition.
- **Attributes Required:** Int 48

---

## **Romina, Saint of the Bud**

![Artwork of the Romina, Saint of the Bud Remembrance from Elden Ring: Shadow of the Erdtree](https://static0.polygonimages.com/wordpress/wp-content/uploads/chorus/uploads/chorus_asset/file/25504616/remembrance_saint_of_the_bud.jpg?q=70&fit=crop&w=825&dpr=1)Image: FromSoftware/Bandai Namco via Polygon

**Remembrance:** Remembrance of the Saint of the Bud  
**Boss:** [Romina, Saint of the Bud](https://www.polygon.com/elden-ring-shadow-erdtree-guide/24186689/romina-saint-bud-location-weakness-strategy-how-to-beat-sote-dlc)  
**Location:** Ancient Ruins of Rauh, beyond Church of the Bud, Main Entrance Site of Grace

### **Reward #1: Poleblade of the Bud**

- **Type:** Halberd (Slash/Pierce)
- **Effect:** Causes scarlet rot buildup (55)
- **Description:** A scarlet glaive with a dangling bud-like blade. Attacks cause buildup of rot.
- **Unique Skill:** Romina’s Purification. Imbues bud-blade with scarlet rot butterflies before unleashing two large sweeping slashes. This was once considered a sacred act of purification.
- **Attributes Required:** Str 14, Dex 22, Arc 20

### **Reward #2: Rotten Butterflies**

- **Type:** Incantation
- **Description:** Summons a myriad of butterflies while performing a gentle whirl. The butterflies break apart on contact, scattering rot and setting off a chain reaction.
- **Attributes Required:** Fai 33

---

## **Metyr, the Mother of Fingers**

![Artwork of the Metyr, the Mother of Fingers Remembrance from Elden Ring: Shadow of the Erdtree](https://static0.polygonimages.com/wordpress/wp-content/uploads/chorus/uploads/chorus_asset/file/25504617/remembrance_mother_fingers.jpg?q=70&fit=crop&w=825&dpr=1)Image: FromSoftware/Bandai Namco via Polygon

**Remembrance:** Remembrance of the Mother of Fingers  
**Boss:** Metyr, the Mother of Fingers  
**Location:** Finger Ruins of Miyr

### **Reward #1: Staff of the Great Beyond**

- **Type:** Glintstone Staff (Strike)
- **Description:** Catalyst for casting both sorceries and incantations.
- **Attributes Required:** Str 7, Int 25, Fai 25

### **Reward #2: Gazing Finger**

- **Type:** Colossal Weapon (Strike)
- **Description:** The head of Metyr, the finger-mother, wielded as a weapon without modification. From within the center of the fingerprint that wrinkles the creature’s foremost protrusion, a tiny wart-like eye gazes vacantly into the beyond.
- **Unique Skill:** Kowtower’s Resentment. Skill performed as a violent bow using a finger’s foremost protrusion. Resentment builds as it is forced to bow, making it explode with anger. Hold button down to further increase resentment.
- **Attributes Required:** Str 20, Dex 8, Int 20, Fai 14

---

## **Elden Ring DLC Final Boss**

![Artwork of the Radahn, Consort of Miquella Remembrance from Elden Ring: Shadow of the Erdtree](https://static0.polygonimages.com/wordpress/wp-content/uploads/chorus/uploads/chorus_asset/file/25504618/remembrance_god_and_lord.jpg?q=70&fit=crop&w=825&dpr=1)Image: FromSoftware/Bandai Namco via Polygon

**Remembrance:** Remembrance of a God and a Lord  
**Boss:** [Promised Consort Radahn](https://www.polygon.com/elden-ring-shadow-erdtree-guide/24191467/radahn-final-boss-location-weakness-strategy-how-to-beat-sote-dlc)/Radahn, Consort of Miquella  
**Location:** [Enir-Ilim](https://www.polygon.com/elden-ring-shadow-erdtree-guide/24186341/enir-ilim-steps-sealing-tree-sote-dlc), from Divine Gate Front Staircase

### **Reward #1: Greatsword of Radahn (Lord)**

- **Type:** Colossal Sword (Standard/Pierce)
- **Description:** Greatswords of black steel wielded by Radahn in his youth. A pair of weapons decorated with a lion mane motif. These were in his possession immediately before his triumph over the stars — the swords of a lord who does not rely on physical strength and gravity alone.
- **Unique Skill:** Promised Consort. Imbue the two greatswords with the light of Miquella, then deliver a slashing attack accompanied by columns of light. Additional input allows for up to two follow-up attacks.
- **Attributes Required:** Str 32, Dex 24, Int 15

### **Reward #2: Greatsword of Radahn (Light)**

- **Type:** Colossal Sword (Standard/Pierce)
- **Description:** Greatswords of black steel wielded by Radahn in his youth. A pair of weapons decorated with a lion mane motif. These were in his possession immediately before his triumph over the stars — the swords of a lord who does not rely on physical strength and gravity alone.
- **Unique Skill:** Lightspeed Slash. Assume a luminous form and leap forward to deliver a downward slash at the speed of light. This attack will be followed up by an additional light attack. Charge to increase power of the skill and number of follow-up attacks.
- **Attributes Required:** Str 32, Dex 24, Int 15

### **Reward #3: Light of Miquella**

- **Type:** Incantation
- **Description:** Annihilates foes with a pillar of light.
- **Attributes Required:** Fai 72

---

Looking for more [Shadow of the Erdtree guides](https://www.polygon.com/e/23944154)? Check out our guides on new Elden Ring DLC [weapons](https://www.polygon.com/e/23944297), [armor](https://www.polygon.com/e/23944296), [bosses](https://www.polygon.com/elden-ring-shadow-erdtree-guide/24180254/all-dlc-boss-locations-bosses-in-order), [map fragments](https://www.polygon.com/e/23942049), and [sites of grace](https://www.polygon.com/e/23946531). We’ve also got location guides on where to find [Scadutree Fragments](https://www.polygon.com/e/23942047) and [Revered Spirit Ashes](https://www.polygon.com/e/23942048), and an [interactive Elden Ring DLC map](https://www.polygon.com/e/23946370).

A malevolent snake writhed within Messmer, and so his very mother plucked out his eye and put in its place a seal of grace. Yet, having done so, her fear compelled her to secret away her child within the realm of shadow. Hidden away—keeping company with the original sin, and a hatred that would not be confined.
